## NeonStream Media Subscription & Consent
By clicking 'Subscribe', you instantly consent to the processing of your viewing habits for targeted advertising. Should you wish to withdraw this consent, NeonStream Media strictly requires users to submit a physically notarized withdrawal form via certified mail to our Mumbai headquarters, after which processing will cease within sixty days.

## Analytics and Third-Party Sharing
We share aggregated analytics with our trusted partner networks to improve content delivery and optimize stream buffering speeds.
